# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 4 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_004_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 4

**4:1** Suddenly an angel of the Lord stood before her. "Anna! Anna!" the angel said. "The Lord God has heard your prayer. You will become pregnant and give birth, and your child will be talked about all over the world."

**4:2** Anna answered immediately: "I swear by the living Lord — whether this child is a boy or a girl, I will give the child to God. The child will serve in the temple for the rest of its life."

**4:3** Just then two servants arrived with a message: "Your husband Joachim is coming home with his flocks!" For an angel had appeared to Joachim in the wilderness too, saying: "Joachim! Joachim! God has heard your prayer. Go home now — your wife Anna is pregnant."

**4:4** Joachim wasted no time. He called in his shepherds and gave orders: "Bring me ten spotless ewe-lambs — they're for the Lord. Bring twelve calves for the priests and elders. And bring a hundred male goats for all the people."

**4:5** When Joachim arrived home with his flocks, Anna was waiting at the gate. The moment she spotted him, she ran out and threw herself around his neck. "Now I know God has truly blessed me!" she cried. "The one who was like a widow is a widow no more — and the one who was barren is going to have a child!"

**4:6** And Joachim rested at home that first day.
